crossRefs.note: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

people.name: Amram
people.line: Father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam

people.name: Hebron
people.line: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi.

people.name: Izhar
people.line: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi; father of Korah.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Uzziel
people.line: Son of Kohath, uncle of Moses and Aaron
